exposure: Attended vs did not attend maternal education classes
History of cesarean section vs no history of cesarean section
History of abortion vs no history of abortion
History of mental disorder vs no history of mental disorder
Difficult delivery vs not difficult delivery
Infant admitted to NICU vs infant not admitted to NICU
Lower vs higher levels of education
Skin-to-skin contact vs no skin-to-skin contact
cohort: 448 women in labor and within the first 24 hours post-delivery
finding: Insufficient maternal education and complicated births requiring infant hospitalization contribute to elevated postpartum anxiety levels.
